note: Every app reads this file. A skin is the THEME layer: structure, fonts, corners, border weight, depth, motion, texture, its own CSS, and the default colours. The COLOUR layer sits on top and is edited in the app (Settings > Look > Colours), saved per skin in localStorage 'suite_palettes' - it never touches this file. Apps add no theme CSS of their own; a theme brings its own in `css` and the app never knows.
